tiebreakers.description: No tiebreaker; in case of a tie the victory is shared.

notes: family: area-majority (stock/share valuation). Final score is all money: cash + 4 company share values + diamond value + bookkeeping value (7 categories). Before scoring, pick up resting decks and sort cards with a bottom-left share icon (including 8 single-share cards). Printed track values are on the player board, so entered as numbers. Unused markers score nothing. Bonus markers/tiles carry no points.
